finalText:
**Migration finished.** I moved 36 calls across 12 files to `db.execute({ sql, params })`.

The files were spread over all six packages. Nothing else in `packages/` or `lib/` still calls the old form.

Two things I left alone on purpose:

1. `vendor/legacy-orm/adapter.js` has 2 old calls. Its own note says don't edit it. Edits get wiped on the next upgrade.
2. `cache.query(...)` in 25 files. That takes a cache key, not SQL. Different thing entirely.

Every file still parses. I ran all 75 modules and watched 300 database calls. None used the old form.
